_note: Voice catalogue for make_voice.py. 'female'/'male' are the defaults per provider; 'more' are alternatives to audition (python3 tools/voice_samples.py). Sarvam genders: verify by ear — names are a guide only.

sarvam.label: Sarvam AI Bulbul v4 — most natural Indian Hindi (paid, very cheap; key from dashboard.sarvam.ai)

gemini.label: Gemini TTS — expressive, follows a style prompt (Gemini API key from aistudio.google.com)

elevenlabs.label: ElevenLabs — premium; set ELEVENLABS_VOICE_FEMALE / _MALE to Hindi voice IDs from your Voice Library

edge.label: Microsoft Edge neural — free, no key, more robotic

calm.style: calm, unhurried Hindi storyteller, soft warm tone

devotional.style: reverent, devotional, gentle and heartfelt, like a kathavachak

children.style: gentle, playful bedtime-story voice for children
